reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream 60ml
reviews.text: I'm not sure if this moisturizer has done all of the work on my skin, but I have noticed recently that my skin has seemed plumper and softer! I have been using a moisturizing serum alongside it, so that likely helped, but since my journey with acne, my skin has been the softest it has been, partly due to this moisturizer!
reviews.zh: 我唔敢講呢支保濕霜做晒所有功勞，但我最近留意到皮膚望落更加飽滿同柔軟！我同時有用緊保濕精華，所以可能都有幫助，但自從我經歷完暗瘡之後，皮膚從未咁柔軟過，呢支保濕霜都佔咗一份功勞！

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream 60ml
reviews.text: I really like it, I think it’s been making my skin look so much firmer and tighter but not in an uncomfortable way, it absorbs very well and it’s quite lightweight. I also believe it’s been helping my skin elasticity.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意，我覺得佢令到我塊面望落實淨咗同緊緻咗，但唔係嗰種唔舒服嘅緊，吸收得好快，而且好輕盈。我亦相信佢對皮膚彈性有幫助。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream 60ml
reviews.text: It's very lightweight moisturizer but I only gave three stars because the packaging is not very good, it broke at the head
reviews.zh: 保濕霜本身好輕身，但因為包裝唔太好，個頂部爛咗，所以我只俾三粒星。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream 60ml
reviews.text: In love with this company and its products. Always the latest in the field, especially now with PDRN.Great moisturizer. Absorbs quickly, skin is soft, radiant and glowing. This entire series is excellent. A great upgrade to my skin routine.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢間公司同佢哋嘅產品。一直喺呢個範疇走在最前，尤其而家加入咗 PDRN。保濕效果一流。吸收得快，皮膚變得柔軟、有光澤又水潤。成個系列都好好用。我護膚程序嘅一大升級。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream 60ml
reviews.text: This moisturizer is perfect for sensitive and combination skin. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and provides deep hydration without feeling greasy or heavy. It calms redness and dryness and works beautifully both morning and night. Sits well under makeup and causes no irritation.
reviews.zh: 呢支保濕霜非常適合敏感肌同混合性肌膚。質地輕盈，吸收得快，提供深層保濕之餘唔會油笠或者厚重。可以紓緩泛紅同乾燥，日頭夜晚都用得。搽完化妝都好貼，冇刺激。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream 60ml
reviews.text:
крем не имеет яркого запаха, легкий, хорошо подходит для комбинированной и склонной к сухости коже. не подойдет, если у вас сухая, атопичная кожа.
ПДРН в составе кот наплакал, но и без него состав классный!
reviews.zh: 面霜冇乜明顯味道，質地輕，幾適合混合性同偏乾嘅肌膚。如果係乾性或者異位性皮膚就未必啱。成份入面 PDRN 少到可憐，但撇除呢點成份都好好！

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream 60ml
reviews.text:
CÔNG DỤNG

- Kem Dưỡng Ẩm Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream 60ml với 100% Hyaluronic Acid phân tử nhỏ và lớn, kem dưỡng thấm sâu, duy trì độ ẩm suốt nhiều giờ, hạn chế tình trạng bong tróc, khô nẻ.

- Phục hồi và tái tạo làn da nhờ PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide) chiết xuất từ DNA cá hồi, được coi là “thần dược tái tạo da”. Thúc đẩy quá trình tái tạo tế bào mới, làm lành các tổn thương da. Tăng sinh collagen và elastin, cải thiện độ đàn hồi và săn chắc.Hỗ trợ phục hồi da sau treatment (Retinol, AHA/BHA, Tretinoin) hoặc sau khi da bị mụn, bong tróc. Giúp da khỏe mạnh từ gốc, giảm tình trạng yếu, mỏng, dễ kích ứng
reviews.zh:
功效

- Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream 60ml 保濕面霜採用100%大小分子透明質酸，乳霜深層滲透，長時間維持肌膚水分，減少甩皮、乾裂情況。

- 透過由三文魚 DNA 萃取嘅 PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide) 修復同再生肌膚，PDRN 被譽為「肌膚再生的神藥」。促進新細胞再生，癒合各種皮膚損傷。增生膠原蛋白同彈性蛋白，改善肌膚彈性同緊緻度。支援做完療程（Retinol、AHA/BHA、Tretinoin）後或者生完暗瘡、甩皮之後嘅肌膚修復。從根本強健肌膚，減少脆弱、薄弱、易受刺激嘅狀況。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream 60ml
reviews.text: Cream delivers deep hydration and leaves the skin feeling plump and bouncy. It’s rich but not greasy, making it a great choice for dry to combo skin. However, those with very oily skin might find it a bit too heavy for daytime use.
reviews.zh: 乳霜提供深層保濕，用後皮膚感覺飽滿有彈性。質地豐盈但不油笠，適合乾性至混合性肌膚使用。不過，非常油性肌膚嘅人可能會覺得日間用稍為厚重。
